# Billing (`billing`) — generic, pattern **transaction-script**, sourcing buy
Deployable `app` (modular-monolith, data store own) · team `solo` · canvas
  `ddd/07-define/billing/bounded-context-canvas.md`
Aggregates needed: **NO — use cases + persistence only**. Purpose: Billing takes the money for a chosen week:
  whenever meals are chosen it charges the household's card through Stripe and tells the rest of the system
  the week is paid. It owns no product rules — a failed charge is reported back to subscriptions, which
  decides what to do. Domain roles: execution-context. Scenarios: S1.
Subdomains: `billing` generic/transaction-script — Charging a card weekly is a solved problem (Stripe,
  commodity evolution); it moves no goal on its own, so buy the provider and keep our side a transaction scri…

# Fulfilment (`fulfilment`) — supporting, pattern **active-record**, sourcing build
Deployable `warehouse` (service, data store own) · team `solo` · canvas
  `ddd/07-define/fulfilment/bounded-context-canvas.md`
Aggregates needed: **NO — use cases + persistence only**. Purpose: Fulfilment turns a paid week into a
  physical box: it builds the picking list, packs the box in the warehouse and hands it to the courier with
  tracking, so the household gets what it chose. It never queries subscriptions; everything it needs arrives
  on week-charged. Domain roles: execution-context. Scenarios: S1.

# Subscriptions (`subscriptions`) — core, pattern **domain-model**, sourcing build
Deployable `app` (modular-monolith, data store own) · team `solo` · canvas
  `ddd/07-define/subscriptions/bounded-context-canvas.md`
Aggregates needed: **yes**. Purpose: Subscriptions decides which meals each household receives each week and
  keeps the standing order alive: it opens, pauses and cancels subscriptions and locks a week's choice before
  the cutoff, so that households keep choosing (G1). It does not charge the card (billing) or pack the box
  (fulfilment). Domain roles: execution-context. Scenarios: S1.
Subdomains: `subscriptions` core/domain-model — G1 (grow active subscribers) is won or lost on how easily a
  household chooses and changes its weekly meals; no off-the-shelf subscription product models cut-of…

| id | actor | produces | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| start-subscription | subscriber | subscription-started |  |
| choose-meals | subscriber | meals-chosen |  |

## Events owned
| id | pivotal | data | triggered_by |
|---|---|---|---|
| subscription-started | yes | subscriptionId | start-subscription |
| meals-chosen | no | subscriptionId, week, recipeIds | choose-meals |

| meals-chosen | event | billing: in-process (flow F1 step 2) | at-least-once | subscriptionId, week, recipeIds | connect |

## Language here
- **Box** — the menu choice for a week
- **Subscription** — A customer's standing weekly order
## Business decisions (canvas)
- A week can be chosen once; a second choice for the same week is rejected
- Choices lock at the weekly cutoff; after it, default meals are assigned
